Xunlei LTD (XNET) Holder Prime Capital Management Company LTD Cut Its Holding by $7.00 Million; Bp Plc F Sponsored Adr 1 Adr R (BP) Shares Declined While Doheny Asset Management Boosted Position 
April 20, 2018 - By Kurt Siggers 
Prime Capital Management Company Ltd decreased its stake in Xunlei Ltd (XNET) by 52.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Prime Capital Management Company Ltd sold 466,616 shares as the company’s stock declined 23.95% with the market. The hedge fund held 427,749 shares of the prepackaged software company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.58 million, down from 894,365 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Prime Capital Management Company Ltd who had been investing in Xunlei Ltd for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $926.47M market cap company. The stock increased 9.67% or $1.22 during the last trading session, reaching $13.88. About 2.22M shares traded or 23.73% up from the average. Xunlei Limited (NASDAQ:XNET) has risen 165.79% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 154.24% the S&P500. 
Doheny Asset Management increased its stake in Bp Plc F Sponsored Adr 1 Adr R (BP) by 19.39% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Doheny Asset Management bought 18,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.20% with the market. The institutional investor held 113,900 shares of the integrated oil company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.79M, up from 95,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Doheny Asset Management who had been investing in Bp Plc F Sponsored Adr 1 Adr R for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $142.25 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.17% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $43.6. About 2.34 million shares traded. BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) has risen 18.43% since April 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 6.88% the S&P500. 
Among 29 analysts covering BP ( NYSE:BP ), 21 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 72% are positive. BP had 60 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, February 12 by Societe Generale. The rating was downgraded by Societe Generale on Wednesday, July 26 to “Hold”. The firm has “Buy” rating by UBS given on Tuesday, September 8. Societe Generale upgraded BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) on Monday, January 18 to “Buy” rating. The rating was downgraded by Morgan Stanley on Tuesday, February 13 to “Equal-Weight”. As per Thursday, December 1, the company rating was upgraded by Independent Research. As per Tuesday, September 15, the company rating was upgraded by Liberum Capital. As per Thursday, September 10, the company rating was upgraded by Bernstein. CLSA downgraded BP p.l.c. (NYSE:BP) on Tuesday, November 15 to “Outperform” rating. The stock has “Outperform” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Monday, September 18. 
Doheny Asset Management, which manages about $245.55 million and $214.55 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Celgene Corp (NASDAQ:CELG) by 19,780 shares to 28,595 shares, valued at $2.98M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2,990 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 87,224 shares, and cut its stake in Comcast Corp New (NASDAQ:CMCSA).   & Ratings   Kurt Siggers
